meta.title: Workstream · A cloud desktop for every task
meta.description: Give each task its own cloud desktop with an AI agent working on it. Watch it live, take over when you want, and keep several going at once.

hero.title: A cloud desktop for every task
hero.body: Workstream gives each piece of work its own computer in the cloud, with an AI agent on it. You watch the screen live, talk to the agent beside it, and take the mouse whenever you want. Your own computer stays free.
hero.pictureAlt: The Workstream dashboard: a list of tasks on the left, and two tasks open side by side, each with its conversation and its live desktop.

ask.title: Say what you want done
ask.body: Write the task in plain words and choose the environment it starts from. A desktop is ready in about two minutes.

watch.title: Watch it happen
watch.body: The agent opens the browser, edits files and runs commands on a real desktop that you see live. Nothing happens off screen.

takeOver.title: Step in when it matters
takeOver.body: Click into the desktop and it is yours. Fix what the agent got wrong, sign in to a site yourself, then hand it back.

solo.title: Run several things at once without a slower laptop

parallel.title: Up to four tasks on one screen
parallel.body: Drag tasks side by side and follow them together. Each has its own desktop, so they never get in each other's way.

free.title: Nothing runs on your machine
free.body: Builds, browsers, containers and test runs happen on the task's desktop. Close your laptop and the work continues.

ready.title: A desktop that already has what you use
ready.body: Chrome, VS Code, a terminal, Docker, Node, Python and .NET are installed. Save a repository, a setup script and your keys as an environment, and every task starts ready.

teams.title: One setup for everyone, and every task in the open

shared.title: Shared environments
shared.body: Set up the project once. A new teammate, or a new agent, starts from the same desktop in minutes instead of a day.

visible.title: See and join any task
visible.body: Everyone on the team can open a running task, read what the agent did, and take over its desktop. Reviews start before the pull request.

control.title: Limits you set, usage you can see
control.body: Each task runs on its own isolated machine. An administrator sets how many run at once and what the team may spend on models, and sees what was used.

closing.title: Start your first task
closing.body: Sign up, write what you want done, and watch a desktop do it.
